author: Nate Miller
title: Braden Shewmake designated for assignment Friday
desc: Braden Shewmake was designated for assignment before Friday's game against the Rangers.
impact: Shewmake was just activated from the IL earlier this week. However, with starting shortstop Jeremy Pena likewise returning from the IL on Friday, Shewmake was made the odd man out in Houston. Shewmake has posted a .695 OPS with three homers and four doubles across 83 plate appearances this season.

author: Nate Miller
title: Jeremy Pena (calf) officially activated Friday
desc: Jeremy Pena (calf) has been activated from the IL ahead of Friday's game against the Rangers.
impact: It was tentatively expected that Pena would return from the IL on Friday, and that has turned out to be the case. The 2025 All-Star has been putting together another solid season for the Astros, but multiple injuries have limited him to 48 games so far. Braden Shewmake was designated for assignment to make room on the roster for Pena.

author: Nate Miller
title: Dillon Dingler (hand) remains out of lineup Friday
desc: Dillon Dingler (hand) still missing from the Tigers' starting lineup on Friday.
impact: Dingler seems close to returning to action, but that won't happen Friday night. Jake Rogers will start behind the plate for the second consecutive day. Dingler could be held out until after the All-Star break at this point.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Shohei Ohtani (knee) scratched from start Friday, will DH
desc: Dodgers superstar Shohei Ohtani has been scratched from Friday's start due to left knee irritation, but will serve as the designated hitter against the D-backs.
impact: In a lengthy statement, the Dodgers announced Ohtani will serve as the designated hitter for the remainder of this weekend's series against the D-backs. Additionally, the club announced that Ohtani will have "interventions" done on his knee during the All-Star break, and the two-way star will be unable to travel to Philadelphia and participate in next week's All-Star game.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Joey Meneses recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Athletics recalled Joey Meneses from Triple-A Las Vegas on Friday.
impact: Meneses was optioned to the minors on July 4 but will receive another opportunity in the majors after Zack Gelof (knee) landed on the injured list. He went 2-for-14 with two doubles and two walks during his first stint with the club. He will provide the Athletics with some infield depth.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Zack Gelof (knee) placed on 10-day IL
desc: The Athletics placed Zack Gelof on the 10-day injured list Friday.
impact: Gelof exited in the third inning of Thursday's game against the Tigers after sustaining a deep laceration beneath his kneecap while chasing a foul ball. With Gelof out, Jeff McNeil is likely to see more opportunities in the infield. In a corresponding move, the Athletics recalled Joey Meneses from Triple-A Las Vegas.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Zack Short has contract selected by Mets
desc: The New York Mets selected Zack Short's contract from Triple-A Syracuse on Friday.
impact: With Mark Vientos (hand) landing on the injured list Friday and Marcus Semien (hip) still sidelined, Short is expected to receive some playing time in the infield. He has made 55 plate appearances between the Mets and Detroit Tigers this season, slashing .159/.278/.205.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Mark Vientos (hand) expected to miss 6-8 weeks
desc: The New York Mets have officially placed Mark Vientos on the injured list Friday, and he is expected to miss six to eight weeks.
impact: Vientos suffered a fractured right hand after being hit by a pitch during Thursday's game against the Royals. He told reporters that he will need to wait for the bone to heal, which is expected to keep him sidelined for more than a month. In a corresponding move, the Mets selected Zack Short's contract from Triple-A Syracuse.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Sprock traded to Blue Jays
desc: The Blue Jays are acquiring Ryan Sprock from Twins for Tommy Nance.
impact: Sprock was in High-A for Minnesota, hitting .297 this season with 38 RBI and 14 stolen bases.

author: Ari Koslow
title: JJ Wetherholt agrees to long-term extension with Cardinals
desc: JJ Wetherholt and the St. Louis Cardinals are in agreement on a long-term contract extension.
impact: The deal is expected to buy out multiple years of free agency for the standout rookie. Wetherholt becomes the latest rookie to land a nine-figure contract, hitting .267 this season with 13 home runs and 36 RBI.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Easton McGee designated for assignment
desc: The Brewers designated Easton McGee for assignment.
impact: McGee loses his spot on the Brewers 40-man roster with the signing of Bryse Wilson.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Drew Rom optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Brewers optioned Drew Rom to Triple-A Nashville.
impact: Rom returns to Triple-A to make room for the signing of Bryse Wilson.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tommy Nance traded to Twins
desc: The Twins are acquiring Tommy Nance from the Blue Jays.
impact: Minnesota enters Friday just one game out of the Wild Card race. Nance has posted a 3.82 ERA across 33 innings pitched this sesson.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jake Irvin (shoulder) transferred to 60-day IL
desc: The Nationals transferred RHP Jake Irvin from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list.
impact: Irvin recently progressed to facing live hitters. He is likely still several weeks away from making his return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cam Sanders optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Pirates optioned Cam Sanders to Triple-A Indianapolis.
impact: Sanders gets optioned for Pittsburgh to bring up a fresh arm for this weekend. He should be called back up after the All-Star break.
